title: Longest Repeating Character Replacement
summary: Solve Longest Repeating Character Replacement using the standard optimized interview approach.
hint: Look for the Sliding Window structure that reduces repeated work.

idea: Window is valid if changes needed fit within k.
Track the most common character count in the window.
Shrink when window length minus max count exceeds k.

approach: Identify the state or invariant needed for Longest Repeating Character Replacement.
Use Sliding Window to process the input efficiently.
Update the result while preserving the invariant.
Return the final value after all relevant input is processed.
pseudocode: while window needs more than k changes:

desktop: function characterReplacement(s, k) { const count = new Map(); let left = 0, best = 0, maxFreq = 0; for (let right = 0; right < s.length; right += 1) { const ch = s[right]; count.set(ch, (count.get(ch) || 0) + 1); maxFreq = Math.max(maxFreq, count.get(ch)); while (right - left + 1 - maxFreq > k) { count.set(s[left], count.get(s[left]) - 1); left += 1; } best = Math.max(best, right - left + 1); } return best; }

class Solution { public int characterReplacement(String s, int k) { int[] count = new int[26]; int left = 0, best = 0, maxFreq = 0; for (int right = 0; right < s.length(); right++) { maxFreq = Math.max(maxFreq, ++count[s.charAt(right) - 'A']); while (right - left + 1 - maxFreq > k) count[s.charAt(left++) - 'A']--; best = Math.max(best, right - left + 1); } return best; } }
